steps.title: Enter public test credentials
steps.observation: The login form accepted the published SauceDemo standard-user credentials; the password remained masked.

steps.title: Inspect the product catalog
steps.observation: The catalog loaded 6 products and included Sauce Labs Backpack with the default az sort.

steps.title: Add Sauce Labs Backpack
steps.observation: Two immediate presses on the product action added and then removed the Backpack; the cart badge returned to empty.

steps.title: Inspect the cart
steps.observation: The cart showed one Sauce Labs Backpack with quantity 1. The item was safely re-added after the rapid repeated action.

steps.title: Begin checkout and stop safely
steps.observation: Checkout opened the customer-information form. No Finish button was present, and the run stopped without submitting an order.

consoleErrors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)
Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)

findings.observation: A second immediate press in the same product-action position reversed the add and emptied the cart.
findings.expected: A rapid repeated action does not silently undo the shopper's intended add.
findings.actual: The first press changed Add to cart to Remove; the immediate second press removed the item and badge.
reproduction: Press Add to cart for Sauce Labs Backpack.
Immediately press the replacement Remove action in the same position.
Observe that the cart badge disappears.

findings.observation: Two Backtrace telemetry submissions returned HTTP 401 and produced browser console errors; the shopping journey still completed.
findings.expected: Background telemetry requests complete without authorization errors or console noise.
findings.actual: The summed-events and unique-events submission endpoints each returned HTTP 401.
reproduction: Open SauceDemo in a fresh browser context.
Watch failed HTTP responses during page load.
Observe 401 responses from the Backtrace summed-events and unique-events submission endpoints.
